messages:
Maria G: Cascade POC wrapped today — positive perf and evals. They want to convert to prod but pushing for 45% off hosted API plus 1yr commit. Need Deal Desk OK and clarity on SLA + security asks. (SOC2, EU-only logs)
Tony L: Nice. What's expected first-year spend / committed $?
Maria G: Looking at ~$180k ARR based on projected 4M tokens/mo. Their legal wants a 99.9% SLA and data residency guarantee.
Jess (SE): POC numbers: 95th latency 120ms, avg cost/mo @ list ~ $24k. 45% drops unit rev below cost with current dedicated capacity assumptions. We can offer quantized model variants to reduce cost but need volume commit.
Ella (RevOps): Heads up — standard max discount on hosted for first year typically 30% with minimum 12mo commit and signed MSA. Anything >30% needs director-level approval + finance signoff. Provide ARR math and justification.
Maria G: Understood. They're also asking for a month-to-month early-exit credit if usage exceeds commit. I've sketched math:
```
List rate: $0.006 / 1k tokens
Projected monthly tokens: 4,000,000
List monthly cost: $24,000
Requested 45% off -> $13,200
1yr commit => ACV = $158,400
Delta vs list = -$86,400
```
Jess (SE): Suggest alternative: 25% off + tiered volume rebate when they cross 1.25x/1.5x usage; and SLA addendum for 99.9% on Dedicated or Private. That keeps unit economics positive.
Deal Desk Bot: Please complete the Deal Desk intake form: https://internal/deal-desk (fields needed: customer ARR, proposed discount %, reason, legal/compliance flags). Attach security questionnaire and SOC2 cert.
Ella (RevOps): For >30% we need: 1) CFO approval 2) customer PO or contract signature 3) finance model showing runway impact. Also confirm whether they require Private deployment; that changes pricing buckets.
Maria G: They prefer hosted but will accept VPC if price parity. Security Q: customer provided initial questionnaire; 60% complete, missing answers on encryption at rest and audit log retention.
Tony L: Any timeline? They want go-live within 6 weeks.
Jess (SE): If we do 25% + rebates + a 6-week onboarding SLA (with dedicated ramp), I can justify to product for a limited 'pilot price' code. That buys time for final legal.
Ella (RevOps): Proposed ask to Deal Desk: 25% off year1, tiered rebate up to 10% at usage thresholds, and a 30-day early-exit credit (pro-rated). Approver needed: Dir RevOps + Head of Sales. Finance signoff required.
Maria G: I'll update the intake with the numbers + attach SQ. Can someone prep a short finance P&L? @Ella (RevOps) @Jess (SE)
Ella (RevOps): I can draft the P&L this afternoon. Please drop the final projected tokens and any special SOW items.
Jess (SE): Will attach a brief note on operational needs (KV cache, prefix warmup) and call out SLA differences for Hosted vs Private.
Maria G: Thanks — filing now. Will ping when submitted. :thumbsup: 
Tony L: Awesome, keep us posted.
Deal Desk Bot: Intake submitted by Maria G — ticket DD-1776-458. Assigning to @Ella (RevOps) for review.
Ella (RevOps): Reviewing. If we can cap discount at 30% upfront and layer rebates to hit equivalent economics, we can greenlight faster. Need CFO loop.
Maria G: Copy. I'll set up quick sync with customer's procurement for PO details tomorrow.
Jess (SE): I'll be on the call. Also flag to legal: EU data residency addendum required.
Maria G: thanks everyone.
